metadata.name: Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology

searches.result:
For the academic year 2025-26, Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology (GIKI) has set the following tuition and accommodation fees:

- **Engineering & Computing Programs**: PKR 470,000 per semester, totaling PKR 940,000 annually.
- **Management Sciences Programs**: PKR 412,500 per semester, totaling PKR 825,000 annually.

An administrative charge of 5% of the semester fee applies if payments are made per semester; however, this charge is waived if the entire annual fee is paid upfront. A non-refundable admission fee of PKR 75,000 is required for Pakistani applicants, with an additional refundable security deposit of PKR 40,000. For international students, the annual tuition fee is set at US$ 5,000. ([giki.edu.pk](https://giki.edu.pk/admissions/admissions-undergraduates/ugrad-fees-and-expenses/?utm_source=openai))

Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology (GIKI) offers a comprehensive range of facilities to support both academic and extracurricular activities. The campus features state-of-the-art classrooms equipped with advanced audio-visual technology, well-equipped research laboratories across various disciplines, and a three-story Central Library housing textbooks, reference materials, and journals. For language development, a sophisticated language laboratory with 25 student booths and an instructor's control panel is available. ([giki.edu.pk](https://giki.edu.pk/campus-life/buildings/?utm_source=openai))

Student accommodation is provided through ten hostels for male students and one for female students, all featuring modern furniture and attached bathrooms. The campus also includes a cafeteria (GIKafe) offering meals and snacks, a bank, and various convenience stores. Ghulam Ishaq Khan Institute of Engineering Sciences and Technology (GIKI) offers a variety of scholarships and financial assistance programs to support students in their academic pursuits. For undergraduate students, GIKI provides:

- **GIK Merit Scholarships**: 20 scholarships awarded based on academic excellence.
- **GIK Alumni Association Scholarships**: 55 scholarships available from the second year onwards, focusing on both need and merit.
- **Need-Cum-Merit Financial Assistance**: 50 scholarships for students demonstrating financial need and strong academic performance.
- **General Financial Assistance**: Covering 10 to 20% of revenue, this assistance is available to eligible students.
- **Provincial Scholarships**: 57 scholarships designated for students from various provinces, including Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Sindh, and Balochistan.
- **Ihsan Trust Loans**: 20 loans offered to students in need.
- **Habbah Trust Loans**: 4 loans available for eligible students.
